generation_scope: Complete in-scope missing reference components across all34locations and shared families; no3D models, excluded rooms or arbitrary new mechanics
counting_rule: Count one selected final/reference image per slot and owner. Existing 45 boards are included. Direct analysis crops, previews, renders and superseded experiments stay in the archive without consuming new design slots. Shared designs count once, with multiple reuse tags.
generation_rule: Only verified missing references. Ordinary structural sheets contain 3–4 assemblies; tiny-component packs contain 10–20 objects. Do not generate repeats to fill an allowance. A directly requested full-view assembly may use one full sheet.
revision_rule: Revisions keep a slot and are tracked separately. At most two generator attempts per new slot without a new explicit review of the rejection reason; no automatic retries.

retry_reasons: Transform rejected oblique panorama into overhead footprint map, remove repeated rock ring and erroneous grid labels
retired_slots.review_notes: R01 was an oblique panorama with standing buildings and inconsistent coordinate ticks. R02 replaces standing buildings with overhead site symbols, uses local hill contours, adds more low beaches and removes the erroneous grid. Both outputs are preserved. B01–B25 and S01–S06 labels are visually present; T01–T08 are defined in region inventory/legend. This label review is not automated spatial/geometry validation. The drawing remains diagrammatic: marker positions, footprint sizes, coastline and bridge-pavilion instance counts are not proven to match layout.json pixel-for-pixel. In particular, the B01 footprint drawing does not visibly establish its printed2.2x1.87km size relative to the whole envelope. Use that value as a proposed reservation, not as a measurement from this image. The main palace reservation does not redefine GEN-37 facade, tower placement, height, stepped wings or roof courtyards. Legacy height/footprint mismatches are recorded; palace geometry remains unresolved separately. Old coordinate conflicts are explicitly proposed relocations for B17/B18/B25/B11. Sky coordinates are horizontal projections only; S03 is an inland lake. No altitude/access/shoreline support geometry is validated. Route lengths are proposed polyline arithmetic, not navigation/collision/terrain-grade or hydrological results. Sea waves are a design appearance, not a tested shader/simulation. Existing GEN-05/06 boards cover other-building vocabulary; no complete architectural kit, foliage mesh, natural-object mesh or world build is produced here. Owner width2.5km now recorded; current PNG older2.2km label and scaling require revision.
